credit: Greg Zaal (original), Jarod Guest (sky edits) / Poly Haven
measurement: Luminance-weighted spherical centroid of unclamped pixels above half peak, solid-angle weighted; HDRLoader flipY accounted for. Vertical-axis rotation only, no horizon warp.
runtime: Same texture and Y rotation for daylight sky and distant environment; luminance limited to16 before upload. Direct sun and water direction match measured elevation and west azimuth. Existing North Shore backdrop is unchanged.
limits: Generic photographic lighting with clear blue sky and sparse clouds, not Vancouver weather capture. Fixed summer-afternoon interpretation, not a date/time solar simulation. Local reflection probes preserve direction and recapture on weather changes.
